module.name: holoscan-denoise
module.description: GPU image denoising and dynamic-range extension: bilateral and non-local-means spatial filters with motion-adaptive temporal filtering on CUDA, VPI 4's temporal noise reduction on the VIC or CUDA, Mertens exposure fusion of 2 or 3 brackets, and a global tone map for high-bit-depth frames.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: VIC
hardware.description: The Video Image Compositor of Jetson Orin or Thor, which runs VPI's temporal noise reduction for the vpi backend when present. Elsewhere VPI runs it on CUDA.
